fact: The second amendment to the World Bank (IBRD) results-based loan to the Kingdom of Morocco, addressed to the Minister of Economy and Finance, funds an upgrade of the GIR-CT system to synchronize central government and municipal systems, with a disbursement-linked result for GIR-CT interfacing in at least 100 large municipalities.
title: Second Amendment to the Original Loan Agreement (P169330/ENNAJAA)
